name: @thirdlight/behavior-build
description: Thirdlight behavior build: the Node-side behavior source parser and static analyzer, the canonical digest-bound `BehaviorManifest` builder and the shared `compileBehavior` over supplied in-memory bytes, and the script type check. It reads no project path, clock, network endpoint or environment, never imports, executes or evaluates project source; the pinned `esbuild@0.28.2` is only a parser/transformer through an in-memory resolver, and the pinned `typescript@5.9.3` only a type checker over the same in-memory files (the one file read is the compiler's own standard-library typings, through TypeScript). Its edges are `project-model`, `esbuild` and `typescript`; it imports no Node built-in, and has no runtime, three, editor, backend, workspace, commands or protocol edge, and no browser globals.
